style.house_style: premium hand-drawn romantic watercolor-and-ink illustration, warm ivory paper grain, fine ink and pencil linework, transparent watercolor blooms, muted vintage palette, tactile clothing detail, soft faded edges
style.paper_tone_lock: neutral warm ivory/off-white paper, not yellow, not parchment, no mustard cast
style.brandmark: tiny low-contrast handwritten @a.storyof.two at top-right on every slide
style.negative_prompt: No photorealism, no yellowish tone, no 3D render, no flat vector art, no stock Indian couple style, no generic model faces, no anime, no Canva quote-card design, no poster design, no random unreadable text, no extra words beyond exact on-image text and brandmark, no crowded props, no mean-spirited humor.

shared_prompt_preamble: Use the attached identity photos as mandatory face, hair, skin tone, body proportion, and wardrobe anchors for Aachu and Zuv. Use the attached style references only for watercolor-and-ink paper texture, line quality, palette, and integrated hand-drawn text. Aachu has large expressive dark eyes, long dark wavy hair, soft oval face, warm medium-brown skin. Zuv has thick dark curly hair, short natural stubble, warm dark almond eyes, grounded posture. In two-shots, Aachu is 5'6 and Zuv is 5'8. Every slide must include exact on-image text in a compact upper label area and tiny @a.storyof.two top-right. Text hierarchy: the main Hinglish keyword or phrase is larger than the translation line, but not poster-sized; the visual scene must carry the joke first.

proof_slide.post_prompt: Create native 3:4 Instagram carousel art, source 1440x1920 for final 1080x1440. Exact on-image text in a compact upper label area, handwritten dark charcoal: BAS 5 MIN / = 40 min + last look. Text hierarchy: BAS 5 MIN is larger than the translation line, but not huge; keep the text compact, around 20-25% of the visual height. The scene must dominate. Scene: warm daily-marriage doorway moment in a small lived-in Indian home. Zuv waits near the door in casual off-white or dark shirt with keys and phone, patient but amused, not annoyed. Aachu is visible in a mirror still doing one last getting-ready thing, playful and alive, one hand near an earring or bag strap. Communicate the joke visually through keys ready, phone in hand, open door, shoes/bag ready, and Aachu smiling knowingly. Lower/middle-lower composition, generous ivory paper space above, fine ink/pencil lines, transparent watercolor blooms, tactile denim/shirt details. Text must be exact, no extra words except tiny @a.storyof.two at top-right.
proof_slide.reels_stories_prompt: Create separate native 9:16 Reels/Stories art at 1080x1920, same scene and exact compact text: BAS 5 MIN / = 40 min + last look. Keep text in the upper third but small enough that the scene dominates. Do not crop from 3:4.
